properties.name: Horn of Africa Zone
properties.principle: Geology: the highland block the Afar triple junction splits, where the Nubian, Somali and Arabian plates part, with the plateaus and coasts round it. The extent is Starcom's: Somalia, Djibouti, Ethiopia and Eritrea, with Somaliland as the source counts it, as Natural Earth draws them; the outer line is Natural Earth's, and where it crosses disputed ground it claims nothing. Inside, the Sectors follow the escarpments (their foot at about 1,200 m on ETOPO1), the Abay and Jemma gorges, the rift and the coasts, never the borders inside the Zone: the Eritrean and Tigray plateaus share a Sector because only the disputed Mereb line divides them.

properties.name: Eritrean and Northern Ethiopian Highlands
properties.character: The high basalt plateau north of the Abay and Jemma gorges, from the Eritrean highlands through Tigray to Gondar, Lake Tana, Gojjam and Wollo: ambas and gorges, the old highland kingdoms, and the theatre of the Tigray war and the Amhara insurgency. ETOPO1 elevation: median 1,884 m (10% below 1,358, 10% above 2,541).

properties.name: Western Lowlands
properties.character: The hot lowlands below the plateau's western escarpment, from Eritrea's Gash and Barka plains through Humera and Metema, Benishangul and the Renaissance Dam, to Gambela and the lower Omo: sesame and cotton farms, refugee camps and the Sudan and South Sudan frontiers. ETOPO1 elevation: median 756 m (10% below 437, 10% above 1,086).

properties.name: Central and Southern Ethiopian Highlands
properties.character: The plateau south of the Abay and Jemma gorges, split by the Main Ethiopian Rift and its lakes: Shewa and Addis Ababa, Wollega, Jimma and Kaffa's coffee forests, Sidama, and east of the Rift the Arsi, Bale and Hararghe highlands. ETOPO1 elevation: median 1,682 m (10% below 1,181, 10% above 2,411).

properties.name: Afar Lowlands and Red Sea Coast
properties.character: The Afar depression below the eastern escarpment and the Red Sea coast from Eritrea's north to Djibouti and the Bab-el-Mandeb: salt flats, lava fields, among the hottest places on Earth, and the ports of Massawa, Assab and Djibouti. ETOPO1 elevation: median 520 m (10% below 53, 10% above 893).

properties.name: Gulf of Aden Coast
properties.character: The Horn's northern face: the Guban coastal plain on the Gulf of Aden and the Golis, Ogo and Cal Madow highlands behind it, from Zeila to Cape Guardafui: ports, livestock exports and the shipping lane offshore. ETOPO1 elevation: median 764 m (10% below 189, 10% above 1,325).

properties.name: Ogaden and Haud
properties.character: The Somali plateau falling south-east from Jijiga and the Haud to the Indian Ocean: arid rangeland of the Shabelle's middle course, the Nugaal valley and Mudug, herders' country of wells and seasonal grazing across the Ethiopia-Somalia line. ETOPO1 elevation: median 573 m (10% below 205, 10% above 1,165).

properties.name: Juba–Shabelle Valleys
properties.character: The lowland valleys of the Juba and the Shabelle and the farmland between them, with the Benadir coast: Somalia's breadbasket, its capital and its ports, and the ground most fought over since 1991. ETOPO1 elevation: median 167 m (10% below 28, 10% above 428).
